subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should normal runtime auth loads be allowed to import retired secret-bearing `auth-profiles.json` into SQLite, or must this recovery stay in doctor/startup migration code?
rationale: The code-level fix restores upgraded installs, but choosing runtime fallback changes a security- and compatibility-sensitive credential migration boundary that existing docs and tests currently keep out of steady-state runtime.

options.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
options.body: Move the recovery into doctor or an explicit startup migration boundary and keep normal auth reads from consuming legacy JSON.

options.title: Approve Runtime Fallback
options.body: Accept the compatibility fallback and update the invariant test, docs, and security expectations around legacy credential JSON.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it while a narrower migration-boundary fix is prepared.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
recommendation.body: Move the recovery into doctor or an explicit startup migration boundary and keep normal auth reads from consuming legacy JSON.

likelyOwner.reason: The auth-profile SQLite refactor and current runtime/store boundary history point here for the boundary decision.
